create_at_update_array: create array update operations using xpx.at(x, idx).set(value) for read-only array element assignment
build_at_add_operation: build in-place array addition using xpx.at(x, idx).add(value) to apply x[idx] += y across array backends
test_at_min_max_methods: test the at.min() and at.max() methods that apply minimum and maximum element-wise updates to array indices
refactor_at_arithmetic_ops: refactor the at.subtract(), at.multiply(), and at.divide() methods to support operator-based in-place arithmetic on arrays
review_at_copy_behavior: review the at class copy parameter behavior that controls whether input arrays are modified in place or copied before update
